title: Giza pink granite hauled 500 miles from Aswan
place_text: Giza Plateau and Aswan quarry, Egypt

tellings.quote: all the pink GR it we find throughout the Giza Plateau came from 500 miles away to the south in the Awan Quarry

plain: All the pink granite found across the Giza Plateau, the site of Egypt's great pyramids, was brought from a quarry at Aswan, some 500 miles to the south. Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient sites, tells Michels this without naming a source, as a sign of how much effort and skill went into the building.
